ruling_1_extraction_conditions.beyond_conditions: The ADR additionally carries the template-echo false-accept probe forward as a standing requirement if the prompt template ever changes. Not a reviewer condition; the correct instinct — it closes the failure path at its source rather than at one point in time.

ruling_2_serving_equivalence_probe.framing: This is explicitly NOT a declaration that 86.33% clears a threshold. No threshold was pre-registered, and inventing one after seeing the result is the exact post-hoc move condition C4 exists to prevent. The probe was specified to QUANTIFY parity; it did so at n=300 with correct statistics. The ruling is narrower: the measured limitation is COMPATIBLE with Plan 2 close and with certification AS SCOPED.
ruling_2_serving_equivalence_probe.why_compatible: Internal validity is intact — all three arms (ZS/FS/QA) were generated on the same vLLM 4-bit + LoRA stack, so the QA-vs-baseline comparison is internally consistent, and the certified system is DEFINED as the adapter as served on the frozen stack. Portability is a separate claim that has not been made and must not be implied.

measured.quality_neutrality: vs train gold on the 41 divergent frames: served F1 0.341 / exact 5, local F1 0.392 / exact 2. A 4-true-positive difference over 96 gold arguments at n=41 — accepted as noise, not a systematic gap. Downgrades severity from quality defect to reproducibility caveat.
measured.confidence_concentration: 0 of 41 divergent frames in the top confidence quartile (chance 25%). Reviewer recomputed P(0 of 41 | uniform) = 7.5e-06 — the concentration is real, not sampling noise. Divergence falls monotonically with acceptance: 13.67% / 12.59% / 9.33% / 6.00% / 0% at 100/90/75/50/25%.
measured.top_quartile_bound: 0/75 carries a 4.80% two-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound (reviewer recomputed; the rule of three would give 4.00%). Attribution corrected in the doc at the reviewer's request.

conditions.1_reoperating_point: CARRIED TO PLAN 3 (calibration has not run). The reassurance is operating-point-dependent: at top-90% acceptance divergence is 12.59%, barely below the 13.67% raw rate. The near-zero result holds only under aggressive abstention. Re-report divergence AT the realised operating point before any stability claim; do not carry '0% / <=4.8%' forward as though it applies at whatever acceptance rate calibration selects.
conditions.2_abstain_flip_location: DISCHARGED, and the answer is worse than the aggregate suggested — reported honestly. The 4 empty_vs_nonempty flips sit at min-logprob percentiles 0.503, 0.507, 0.370, 0.347. None reaches the top quartile, but TWO sit just above the median, so they survive into the accepted set at plausible operating points. The flip rate is now stated as 1.3-1.8% at plausible operating points, i.e. it can exceed the raw 1.3%.
conditions.3_confidence_provenance: DISCHARGED and independently verified in source. jobs/plan2_prediction_generation.py: chosen_transition_logprobs(request_output.outputs[0]) under SamplingParams(temperature=0.0, max_tokens=256, logprobs=1). ruling_2_serving_equivalence_probe.standing_limitation: Carry into Plan 4 limitations and any model/report card, scoped to the exact serving stack: 13.67% raw divergence; 1.3-1.8% abstain/extract flip rate at plausible operating points; quality-neutrality; and confidence-concentration with its 4.80% upper bound in the top quartile. Probe frames are train-split only, so the rate may differ on certification/final splits. Cause is not isolated to a specific kernel.

headline_assessment.finding: Grounding, not structure, is what discriminates — and the comparison reverses between stages. Structurally the arms are saturated and near-indistinguishable (FS 9,105 >= QA 9,085 > ZS 8,959). On grounding they separate widely (QA 95.7% vs FS 68.1% vs ZS 39.4%), with ungrounded spans at QA 340 (3.7%) against ZS 5,355 (58.7%) — a ~16x separation on exactly the axis structural validity could not see. The adapter's principal learned behaviour is grounding fidelity, not format compliance.
headline_assessment.honesty_boundary_upheld: 'Valid' means parsed AND grounded — NOT correct. A span can point at real text and still name the wrong entity or role. Correctness is scored only against sealed gold during certification. 95.7% must never be quoted as accuracy, and H1/H2 remain genuinely open. The write-up states this explicitly.
headline_assessment.extraction_ruling_vindicated_with_a_cave: The adopt ruling is vindicated on the merits: under the strict parser both baselines scored 0, which would have attributed a missing stop sequence to model quality when the real deficit is grounding. The fair statement is that 'regenerate' would have reached the same place for the recoverable mass; what actually prevented a wrong conclusion was condition C3, which forced empty frames to be first-class.
headline_assessment.promoted_finding: On content-bearing frames the ZERO-shot baseline beats the FEW-shot one (3,550 vs 3,330), and FS emits 63x more empty frames (2,887 vs 46). The two frozen demonstrations appear to have taught emptiness and continuation, actively harming the arm. Promoted at the reviewer's request from an aside to a stated result, scoped to these two demonstrations, this template and this model.
